en: The postcard depicts a black and white photograph of a large, multi-story residential building with a fenced yard, surrounded by trees. The house has a tiled roof, multiple windows, and a prominent balcony with a decorative railing. There is handwritten text at the bottom of the photograph. The reverse side contains a blue stamp for the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont, more handwritten notes, and printed information from the publisher.
